decisive_items: He had undergone chemoradiotherapy 15 years earlier for squamous cell carcinoma of the left buccal mucosa
spindle cells were positive for vimentin, α-smooth muscle actin, p63, p53, and CD68
The spindle cells had basophilic cytoplasm, bizarre nuclei, and atypical mitoses
response.rationale: Prior SCC, p63/p53-positive spindle cells, and atypical mitoses favor sarcomatoid squamous cell carcinoma over other spindle-cell malignancies; MFH, osteosarcoma, and IMT lack this squamous lineage context.

rejected.why: Bone destruction alone is nonspecific; no osteoid or tumor bone and IHC do not support osteosarcoma.
Inflammatory stroma and SMA positivity are present, but atypical mitoses, p53/p63, high Ki-67, and bone destruction favor malignancy over IMT.
CD68 and pleomorphic spindle cells suggest MFH, but p63 positivity and prior SCC favor sarcomatoid squamous carcinoma; MFH is typically p63-negative.
Spindle cell carcinoma is a synonym but less histogenetically specific; p63 and prior SCC support the squamous qualifier.
